svg.title: Self-attention: the matrix and the causal mask
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Self-attention: the matrix and the causal mask” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A four-by-four attention matrix for the sentence 'the cat sat down'. Each cell in the lower triangle carries its post-softmax weight, hachured more densely where the weight is larger; the upper triangle is crossed out in red and enclosed by a heavy red staircase labelled causal mask, showing that each token can attend only to itself and the tokens before it.
svg.text: Self-attention: the matrix and the causal mask
draw it from memory, then compare
